_comment: What the recorder must have seen after gate.py check-console (gates/console/check.py): gate_maintainer signing in through the console's origin, Polaris 1.6.0 asking the policy endpoint, which lets it read and refuses it a write (ADR-026, ADR-028, ADR-034). The browser's own requests reach Polaris directly, so the recorder sees only Polaris's questions to the policy endpoint, asked by its `Apache-HttpClient/` client. Read with standins.json, whose must-nots hold for every record. Matched by gates/traffic.py; checked in a step of its own, since the console never blocks (ADR-028).

expectations.name: OPA allowed gate_maintainer to list the catalogs, asked by Polaris
OPA refused gate_maintainer creating a catalog, asked by Polaris
OPA never allowed gate_maintainer anything but a read
